paper_information.title: Diseases of Groundnut
paper_information.abstract_summary: This article describes in detail the major diseases of groundnut, its occurrence, distribution, losses caused by them, diagnostic symptoms, and epidemiology besides aflatoxin contamination. Various management options including host plant resistance, cultural methods, botanicals, biological control, chemical methods, and integrated disease management are reviewed.
paper_information.research_objective: To review and describe major diseases of groundnut, their symptoms, losses, epidemiology, and management practices.
important_findings: Collar rot, stem rot, dry root rot, early and late leaf spots, rust, bud necrosis, and aflatoxin contamination are economically important problems.

diseases.causal_agent: Alternaria alternata (also A. tenuissima, A. arachidis, A. longipes)

Weed hosts like water hyacinth (Eichhornia crassipes), Pistia stratiotes, sesame, sunflower

general: Terminal bud necrosis, severe stunting, and proliferation of axillary shoots
